articles.title: Binance says MiCA should be judged by who it licenses, not who it excludes
articles.snippet: Europe head Gillian Lynch said Binance met Greece's licensing requirements and that the company remains committed to the EU, despite withdrawing its MiCA application days before the July 1 deadline.

articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: Upbit says it only expressed interest in future OUSD participation
articles.snippet: Upbit said it only expressed interest in potentially joining the OpenStandard ecosystem in the future, as several South Korean firms distanced themselves from the OUSD initiative.

articles.title: Taiwan Passes Sweeping Crypto Law With Licensing, Stablecoin Rules
articles.snippet: The new law puts virtual asset firms under FSC oversight for the first time and sets reserve-and-trust rules for stablecoins.
